node.title: Mattarei affine coset-pair bound
node.statement: Let K<=F_p^* have order m and index d=(p-1)/m. If d>=4 and d^3>=4m, every simultaneous membership fiber of two nonconstant nonproportional affine forms has size <3*2^(-2/3)m^(2/3). Mattarei's arbitrary Fermat coefficients cover slopes outside K. The hypotheses hold at all official H3 rows for m=n and m=3n. This prime-field pointwise theorem bypasses, but does not refute, the in-house one-polynomial Stepanov barrier.
